purpose: Close the M0-06 engineering-evidence attempt-integrity gaps in the authoritative cargo xtask quality runner without changing product behavior or qualification state.

change.public_seam: cargo xtask quality returned verdict and retained target/quality/evidence attempt
runner_changes: A target/quality/evidence attempt path is created exclusively and an existing path is a fail-closed error; evidence is never overwritten.
Trusted CI rejects a GITHUB_SHA that differs from the controlled git revision before gate selection.
Trusted CI accepts only GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT=1; a retried workflow attempt is retained as failed aggregator evidence rather than accepted as a fresh pass.
unchanged: All 25 gate IDs, stages, owners, timeouts, memory declarations, activation, exception classes, thresholds, targets, commands, and selection rules.
Developer evidence remains diagnostic and non-merge-eligible.
Release Qualification Cells remain Specified; this engineering runner does not qualify a product artifact.

detection_gained: A same-attempt evidence collision cannot replace a retained result.
A trusted CI result cannot be accepted for a source revision other than the controlled git revision.
A trusted CI retry cannot turn an earlier failing run into a fresh green attempt.

old.result: Before the change, a pre-created target/quality/evidence attempt path was silently replaced and the public runner returned success.

new.result: The public runner now returns a retained failed verdict for overwrite, stale source, and retry inputs. These local results are diagnostic only.

representative_old_new_evidence.dual_run_conclusion: The failing overwrite reproducer remains represented by the retained regression test. No prior failed attempt is removed, reclassified, or converted into a qualification claim.

compatibility_and_recovery.compatibility: The cargo xtask quality command and JSON evidence schema remain compatible. A duplicate attempt identity now fails instead of replacing prior evidence.
compatibility_and_recovery.recovery: Create a new run with its own fresh attempt identity after correcting the underlying failure. Do not delete, rename, or overwrite an existing evidence attempt.

approval.attribution: No implementation agent, reviewer, or repository owner is recorded as granting a required approval.

qualification_claim: None. This record does not claim a qualified cell, trusted CI pass, merge eligibility, release readiness, or role approval.
